prompt: State the principle of conservation of momentum.
hints: State what happens to the total momentum and under what condition.
solution: The total momentum of an isolated system remains constant (or: total momentum before a collision equals total momentum after a collision provided no resultant external force acts).
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: State the controlled definition precisely: the total momentum of an isolated system remains constant.
Step 2: Note acceptable Cambridge variants mentioning 'no resultant external force'.

mark_scheme.criterion: The total momentum of an isolated system remains constant (accept: in a closed system, total momentum before collision equals total momentum after collision / provided no resultant external force acts)
